top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regarding inappropriate relationship with minor (26 TAC §HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regar)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three staff files hired after 09/01/2023 did not have a pre-employment affidavit available for review. Licensing staff provided a copy of form 2912 via email for staff to complete while Licensing was present.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.
